scopeAndPrivacyGuards.rule: Compose shared groups once. Resolve alerts/connections per selected configured offering/activity; a union of category candidates never enables every branch or widens permissions.

Personal preferences follow the user identity. Business event routing or system ownership requires current business/location permission and actual supported contract.
Constrain affected class/actions only. Keep permitted confirmed information with its confirmation time. Authorization, import/sync health and individual unknown command outcome are separate.

Keep clinical records, symptoms/results, therapy notes, financial account details, discreet item/session details and sensitive customer intake out of shared alerts, provider diagnostics, exports and concept imagery. Only purpose-limited authorized projections are allowed.
Category choice, license declaration, merchant claim or provider selection never proves eligibility, verification, regulated execution permission or resource capacity.
Merchant operations use Africa/Nairobi; UTC instants remain instants and local dates remain dates. No operational timezone picker. Supported personal time/date formatting does not change commitments.

Configuration/source changes preserve already accepted specification, price, policy, workflow and allocation identities. Owner cutover/rollback requires explicit reviewed reconciliation, never an unsupervised writer toggle.

Hide unauthorized destinations and search metadata. An actor explicitly allowed to discover a section may see an honest unavailable explanation when its capability is unsupported, with no working editor. Capability, approved platform permission, actor/location grant, current workflow/version/state and source/connector operation support constrain every action. UI hiding alone is not authorization.
Show only registered supported events/channels. A selected channel, saved preference, queued test or account badge does not prove channel verification or delivered message.
